name: RecipeSage
description: A Collaborative Recipe Keeper, Meal Planner, and Shopping List Organizer in PWA form.

issues.title: Allow collaborative editing of shared recipes
Find/replace ingredient names across multiple different recipes
Add complete recipe export with images
Have options view on the right-click within meal-planner
Add export as a self-contained webpage
iOS does not allow purchases, shows strange unavailable state
